assets.story-interactions-v2.png: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW high-quality production interaction-pose atlas for a 2D cartoon game cinematic. Preserve these exact characters and polished shaded illustrative art. Critical: the fish Dourado is an actual tiny pet golden-orange fish with cream belly, orange fins and expressive dark eyes. Fish must be physically integrated with hands or mouth in the SAME illustration; never a floating collectible, no stars/glitter. Exactly FOUR finished isolated story poses in a strict 2 columns x 2 rows, 1536x1024 PNG with true transparent alpha, cell size 768x512. All characters and fish fully inside their cell, at least 20px transparent margin. TOP LEFT: Full-body Bento facing three-quarter RIGHT, looking tenderly down at Dourado lying in his cupped hands against chest; fingers visibly wrap under and around the fish with correct overlap, natural contact, fish looks back at him. TOP RIGHT: A SINGLE composed two-character interaction: Bento on LEFT holding Dourado in his outstretched palm; smaller Jaca on RIGHT facing LEFT leans in mischievously, reaching fingers toward the fish; fish looks alarmed at Jaca, its mouth just open. Show all three in ONE cohesive composition with believable hands, eyelines and scale: Bento about 1.3 times Jaca height. Both full bodies, characters not overlapping each other's faces. BOTTOM LEFT: Full-body Jaca facing LEFT, recoiling in shocked comic surprise, eyes crossed looking at Dourado whose small open mouth is visibly CLAMPED around the very TIP of Jaca's long snout. The fish hangs horizontally LEFT of the snout, its head/mouth pointing RIGHT toward the contact, tail pointing LEFT. Physically clear contact: fish upper and lower lips hug the green tip of snout; not just a fish pasted nearby. The fish is about one quarter of Jaca's head length. Jaca's hands splayed in surprise; no blood, no injury, gentle cartoon gag. BOTTOM RIGHT: Full-body Bento facing three-quarter RIGHT, fiercely protective and shouting, ONE arm securely cradles Dourado against his chest, the other points accusingly RIGHT. Fingers and forearm visibly surround the pet; fish peeks safely from his arm. Fish must be same exact orange pet in every cell, no duplication. Original expressive poses, rich hand-painted cel shading, clean dark outlines, strong readable silhouettes, lovingly finished art. No background, floor, water, shadows, typography, labels, speech balloons, grids, borders or glow. True transparent background. Fish is part of each pose, not a separate overlay.
